thread:
ana: Thanks everyone for the great all-hands. Per the incident segment, here's a short follow-up thread to capture open owners and quick clarifications. Link to the RCA: https://go.redwood/rca/INC-20260321 :point_right:

sam: Got it — thanks Ana. Quick Q for leadership: is the Dedicated capacity increase we mentioned gated on the autoscaler fixes from the RCA or is that separate?

matt: Short answer: partly gated. We won't advertise expanded Dedicated until autoscaler regression is in staging. That fix is AI-2 below. Non-blocking improvements (capacity planning docs, interim bump) can proceed.

devon: Can we get the list of action items here? I'll track in the ops sprint board.

ana (ana): sure — listing quick ones I called out in the all-hands: 
- AI-1: Add per-tenant ingress throttling telemetry to Console (owner: devon) — due 2026-04-04
- AI-2: Autoscaler stability patch + e2e test (owner: lee) — due 2026-03-30
- AI-3: Fallback routing policy for capacity outs (owner: sam) — due 2026-04-07
- AI-4: Postmortem runbook update & playbook link in Oncall channel (owner: catalina) — due 2026-03-27

lee: confirming AI-2 — PR in flight, will request review tonight. e2e will run in CI and a smoke staging deploy next week.

catalina: AI-4 will include the new checklist for early detection (latency spike thresholds) + a short pager template. I'll post the doc in #eng-oncall when ready.

sam: For AI-3, do we have an existing low-latency fallback model set? if not, that's a quick spike.

matt: We have model-variants v1/v1-quant as fallbacks. Sam — scope the policy so it hits variant routing first then region failover. Keep us posted on cost/latency tradeoffs.

ops-bot: New RCA uploaded by ana: https://go.redwood/rca/INC-20260321 — summary: KV-cache eviction + autoscaler race -> transient capacity loss, estimated impact 22 minutes peak, customer-facing errors for <1% requests.

devon: Small ask — can we add a single table to the RCA with the exact timeline (UTC) and who took which action? helps SRE handoffs.

ana (ana): yes, adding that now. Will update RCA and ping here when done.

lee: quick note on tests: the e2e will include a synthetic KV cache churn scenario. snippet of test config: 
```
# stress-kv.yml
clients: 200
kv_keys: 100000
evict_rate: 0.6
```

sam: re: communication: any expected customer outreach? product asked to wait until we confirm autoscaler patch timeline. If AI-2 slips, we'll send a brief note.

matt: agreed. product/CS will draft a template; leadership wants to avoid alarm but be transparent.

catalina: I've assigned AI-4 in the runbook tracker and added a draft pager template. Link: https://go.redwood/doc/runbooks/incident-playbook (internal).

devon: I'll create the sprint ticket for AI-1 now and link to the RCA + runbook.

ana (ana): thank you all. one ask from leadership: please update the sprint cards with "RCA-linked" label so we can report status at next leadership sync.

matt: also, quick ask — any blockers that need exec help? call them out here.

sam: nothing that needs exec help today. we might need faster approvals for an extra staging node if autoscaler tests show flakiness; will flag if that becomes real. :thumbsup:

ana (ana): I'll close this thread after the RCA timeline table and the sprint cards are linked. If you pick ownership please react with :white_check_mark: so I can move things to 'in-progress'.

lee: ✅

catalina: ✅

devon: ✅

ana (ana): updated RCA with timeline and action assignments: https://go.redwood/rca/INC-20260321#timeline — last update 1901234598 UTC. Closing notes: we'll review progress in next all-hands follow-up and put a short update in #customers for transparency if product agrees.

matt: Thanks everyone for the rapid follow-through.

(owning managers: please ensure these AIs are in the next sprint grooming)
